sections.extract: Theorem (Chevalley-Shephard-Todd) Let I ⊂S be a subset such that WI = ⟨I⟩⊂W is ﬁnite. Then the ring of WI-invariants RWI = {x ∈R | w · x = x, ∀w ∈W} is a polynomial ring, and R is a Z-graded free module over RWI of ﬁnite rank.

sections.extract: A positive result of Soergel's Conjecture has a very important implication in the larger theory.
